# truefoundry_gateway_budget_config (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway budget configuration: spend and token limits applied to matching requests, with optional alerting. Applied as a `gateway-budget-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The budget config is a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces all budget rules. Import the existing config with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_budget_config.example gateway-budget-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway budget config (singleton — define at most one).
resource "truefoundry_gateway_budget_config" "budget" {
  name = "budget"

  rules = [
    # Daily cost cap per gateway cluster with a Slack alert at 25% usage.
    {
      id       = "cluster-daily-cap"
      limit_to = 150
      unit     = "cost_per_day"

      when = {
        metadata = { tfy_gateway_cluster = "my-cluster" }
      }

      alerts = {
        thresholds = [25]
        notification_targets = [
          {
            type                 = "slack-webhook"
            notification_channel = "my-tenant:slack:slack-webhooks:notification-channel:team-ai-foundation"
          },
        ]
      }
    },

    # Per-user monthly token budget for one model, audit only.
    {
      id       = "per-user-tokens"
      limit_to = 1000000
      unit     = "tokens_per_month"

      when = {
        models = ["my-tenant:azure-openai:eu:model:gpt-4o"]
      }

      budget_applies_per = ["user"]
      audit_mode         = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the budget config (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens).
- `rules` (Attributes Set) Budget rules. A request that matches several rules is limited by each of them; order is not significant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway budget config.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `id` (String) Identifier of this rule, unique within the config.
- `limit_to` (Number) Budget limit: cost in USD for cost units, token count for token units.
- `unit` (String) Unit and period of the limit. One of: `cost_per_day`, `cost_per_week`, `cost_per_month`, `cost_per_quarter`, `tokens_per_day`, `tokens_per_month`.
- `when` (Attributes) Requests this rule applies to; all given conditions must match. An empty block matches every request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when))

Optional:

- `alerts` (Attributes) Alerting when usage crosses thresholds of the limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--alerts))
- `audit_mode` (Boolean) Only record violations instead of blocking requests over the limit.
- `budget_applies_per` (Set of String) Dimensions the budget is tracked per (each distinct value gets its own budget) instead of one shared budget, e.g. ["user"].

<a id="nestedatt--rules--when"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when`

Optional:

- `metadata` (Map of String) Request metadata key-value pairs to match, e.g. {tfy_gateway_cluster = "..."}.
- `models` (Set of String) Model integration FQNs to match.
- `subjects` (Set of String) Calling subjects to match, as `<subject_type>:<name>` with subject type `user`, `virtualaccount`, or `team`.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--alerts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.alerts`

Required:

- `notification_targets` (Attributes Set) Receivers of the alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--alerts--notification_targets))
- `thresholds` (Set of Number) Usage percentages of the limit at which to alert, e.g. [50, 90].

<a id="nestedatt--rules--alerts--notification_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.alerts.notification_targets`

Required:

- `notification_channel` (String) FQN of the notification channel integration to send through, e.g. my-tenant:slack:slack-webhooks:notification-channel:team-ai-foundation.
- `type` (String) Receiver type. One of: `email`, `slack-webhook`, `slack-bot`, `pagerduty`, `ms-teams-webhook`.

Optional:

- `channels` (Set of String) Slack channels to post to (slack-bot targets only).
- `to_emails` (Set of String) Recipient addresses (email targets only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The budget config is a tenant-wide singleton; its import ID is the
# fixed string "gateway-budget-config".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_budget_config.budget gateway-budget-config
```
